name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from overload and keep working when the connection is lost. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team organises service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare, then mark the order as ready and collected.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU WON’T MAKE
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how much time it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s capabilities.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Add on-the-spot orders to the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what’s next and what’s ready, and warns you when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect the kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP WORKING WHEN THE CONNECTION IS LOST
Switch on offline protection: if the connection is lost, pre-orders are paused so nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders taken on the device are kept and synced when the connection is restored.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is intended for food truck owners and their staff. To sign in you need a HatchGrab account.
whatsNew:
HatchGrab now supports 60 languages.

Print order tickets on a kitchen printer on your local network, as well as over Bluetooth.

Bug fixes and improvements.
shortDescription: Pre-orders from a food truck, choice of collection time and a kitchen screen.
